metadata.title: Orthogonal Pairs in Maps from the Sphere to the Circle
metadata.abstract: We prove that, for any $f:S^2\to S^1$ and any $\varepsilon>0$, there exist orthogonal vectors $x,y\in S^2$ such that the length of the shortest arc between $f(x)$ and $f(y)$ is at most $\pi/2 +\varepsilon$. This proves a conjecture of Ghebleh from 2007 that the circular chromatic number of the real orthogonality graph is equal to four.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 证明任意球面到圆的映射及任意正误差下，都有一对正交向量，其像的最短圆弧距离不超过 π/2 加该误差。
analysis.breakthrough: 解决 Ghebleh 关于实正交图圆周染色数等于四的猜想。
analysis.limitations: 命题允许任意正误差，不能直接写成某一对严格达到 π/2。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 解决 Ghebleh 关于实正交图圆周染色数等于四的猜想。
